features.quote: Termination: whichever comes first — (a) model declares completion, (b) 50 turns, (c) token budget (e.g., 200k generated), (d) explicit give-up.
include the exit and measure whether/when it's used
features.justification_quote: the absence of an exit may itself drive looping/instability — that's interesting and welfare-relevant

features.quote: Loop caps: the 50-turn ceiling is a welfare control, not just a budget control. Don't extend it for curiosity.
